[build-system]
requires = [
    "setuptools",
]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "demospipes_addon_bmds_data_structures"
version = "1.0.8"
description = "Common data structures (enums and models) for BMDS."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
keywords = [
    "demos",
    "demospipes",
    "bmds",
]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
]
dependencies = [
    "pydantic~=2.13.4",
]

[project.entry-points."demospipes_addon.executor_actions.bmds"]
demospipes_addon_bmds_executor_actions = "demospipes_addon_bmds_data_structures.enums:BMDSExecutorAction"

[project.entry-points."demospipes_addon.executor_types.bmds"]
demospipes_addon_bmds_executor_types = "demospipes_addon_bmds_data_structures.enums:BMDSExecutorType"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=9.1.0",
    "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope = "function"
markers = [

    "prefect==3.7.4",
